// diagnostic

E3302

Target `{triple}` is not available.

What

Target `{triple}` is not available.

Why

Jet has no backend for this target, or the target triple is not recognised. `wasm32-wasip2` is the supported WASI Preview 2 server Component target. A `jet build` or `jet run` run reports this target-support diagnostic.

Fix

Run `jet self doctor --target=<triple>` to see what's missing; use `wasm32-wasip2` for a WASI Preview 2 server.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3302: tests/ui/inspect_target_unknown_machine_e3302.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownTarget]: Target `nowhere` is not available
 Why: The name is not a declared target machine
 Fix: Run `jet inspect target <machine>` with one of board.sensor_v1, board.virt_aarch64, wasm.browser, wasm.wasi, wasm.no-os, hosted
